Style/medium: soft cel-shaded Japanese animation illustration for a visual novel; period-accurate 1920s Beiping clothing and architecture.
Rendering: broad flat color planes and large simple shadow shapes; two or three value groups per object with clear value separation; crisp silhouette, hard edges only at the focal silhouette, soft edges inside shadow masses; grouped hair and fabric masses with few strand and fold lines; matte surfaces. Translate fine detail into clean, organized, medium-scale shapes rather than micro-texture.

Constraints: no text, no watermark, no modern objects.
